name: matecart
description: MateCart white-label e-commerce platform by NetaMate Solutions (monorepo root).

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.stack:rebuild: docker compose build --pull && docker compose up -d --wait --force-recreate
scripts.api:lint:commerce: docker compose run --rm --no-deps commerce-api sh -c "ruff check . && ruff format --check . && mypy ."
scripts.api:lint:control: docker compose run --rm --no-deps control-api sh -c "ruff check . && ruff format --check . && mypy ."
scripts.api:format: docker compose run --rm --no-deps commerce-api ruff format . && docker compose run --rm --no-deps control-api ruff format .
scripts.api:schema: docker compose run --rm --no-deps commerce-api python manage.py spectacular --file openapi.yaml --validate --fail-on-warn && docker compose run --rm --no-deps control-api python manage.py spectacular --file openapi.yaml --validate --fail-on-warn
scripts.api:celery-check: docker compose exec commerce-api python manage.py check_celery
